newsitem.title: USA: Allied Irish's First Maryland files debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Allied Irish's First Maryland files debt shelf.

text.p: First Maryland Bancorp filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $350 million in subordinated debt securities.
Allied Irish Banks Plc owns 100 percent of the common stock and controls 99 percent of the voting power of the capital stock.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, principally to fund investments in, or extensions of credit to, the company's banking and nonbanking subsidiaries, including to allow its subsidiaries to repay borrowings incurred by such subsidiaries.
